Interactive D3 parallel coordinates

pv_parallel.Rd

Each row of the data becomes one line threading across a set of vertical axes, one per numeric column, each on its own independent scale. The shape of a line is the row's profile; bundles of similar shapes are the clusters.

Usage

pv_parallel(
  data,
  columns,
  color = NULL,
  label = NULL,
  title = NULL,
  subtitle = NULL,
  mode = "auto",
  duration = 500,
  source = NULL,
  width = NULL,
  height = NULL,
  elementId = NULL
)

Arguments

data

A data frame.

columns

Character vector of 2–8 numeric column names — one vertical axis each, in this order.

color

Optional name of a categorical column (max 3 distinct values keeps overlapping lines distinguishable; more will error).

label

Optional name of a column shown first in tooltips.

title, subtitle

Optional chart heading text.

mode

"auto" (default: follow the viewer's light/dark setting), "light", or "dark".

duration

Entrance transition length in ms.

source

Optional source/credit line, shown small and grey at the bottom left — e.g. "Source: Bundesamt für Statistik".

width, height, elementId

Standard htmlwidgets sizing arguments.

Value

An htmlwidget.

Details

The axes are interactive filters: drag along any axis to brush a value range — rows outside it fade out, and brushes on several axes combine so only rows passing all of them stay lit. Double-click an axis to clear its brush. Hovering a line raises it and reads out the full row. In Shiny, every brush change reports the rows passing all the active brushes (each row's label, or its row number when no label is mapped) as input$<outputId>_brush.

Rows with a missing value on any axis are dropped with a warning — a broken polyline would be unreadable.

Examples

# Land-use mix per city: share of each city's total area, in percent.
lu <- pv_city_landuse
lu$share <- 100 * lu$hectares / ave(lu$hectares, lu$city, FUN = sum)
wide <- reshape(
  lu[lu$category %in% c("Buildings", "Agriculture", "Forest"),
     c("city", "category", "share")],
  direction = "wide", idvar = "city", timevar = "category")
names(wide) <- sub("^share\\.", "", names(wide))
pv_parallel(wide, columns = c("Buildings", "Agriculture", "Forest"),
            label = "city", title = "How Swiss cities use their land")
